items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: Boy called Curly. He died. Other boy used to play with him with a guitar. I called Willie B. He played steel guitar. They were good. I played with them.

ctx.x: Well, let's see now. Who else were you thinking about, Dewey? That sounded good. You have any good jug players around? Now, let's see.

Well, let me see. We had another boy. Little jug pretty good around here. Boy called Curly. He died. Other boy used to play with him with a guitar. I called Willie B. He played steel guitar. They were good. I played with them.
What's a steel guitar look like?
